title.narrative: Strengthening the resilience and capacity of Public Broadcasting in times of war

description.narrative:
A direct award to be granted to the Joint Stock Company ¿Public Broadcasting Company of Ukraine¿ (UA: PBC) to support the implementation of the action ¿Strengthening the Public Broadcasting capacity to operate during war and other emergencies¿. The funding will allow to transform the broadcaster¿s operations in addressing the immediate needs posed by war and at the same time fulfilling its mission in supporting independent media environment.

Overall objective (Impact): The Public Broadcasting has transformed its activities in line with the challenges of Russia's war against Ukraine and is fulfilling its mission and tasks in the course of provision of access to different types of content to the audience, by moving away from being a state broadcaster and constantly building its capacity as an effective public service broadcaster, introducing democratic values in the media environment and in Ukrainian society in general.

In particular, the grant focuses on:

1.    Content production and content purchase, including for regional branches:

- content production (digital content, incl. tik tok production, documentaries, historic series, cartoons, films);

- content purchaise (TV shows, melodrama mini-series, historical, cultural and travel documentaries, children`s films);

2.    Immediate response to needs caused by war:

- purchase of necessary services and goods: internet-services, signal delivery, content delivery network, cloud resources and services, software for broadcasting, services for infrastructure maintenance;

- staff relocation and accommodation during National Marathon, in Lviv and Uzhgorod, up to 6 months, up to 60 people.

3.    Completion of Lviv and Uzhhorod centers.

4.    Restoration works for the main broadcasting center in Kyiv:

- conservation of the building;

- relocation from Pencil TV centre to Khreshchatyk and reconstructions in Khreshchatyk street;

- renovation of equipment and purchase of additional equipment;

- restoration works for launching 2 new studio control rooms and editorial offices;

- arrangement of a shelter in Khreshchatyk centre;

5.    Building the new regional broadcasting centre in Cherkasy.

6.    Promotion of UA: PBC brand.

The action is nationwide. It contributes to the country¿s recovery and resilience and is in line with EU policy and assistance provided thus far.
